headline: BlackRock Bitcoin ETF Suffers Record Single-Day Outflow of $541 Million
summary: Investors withdrew $541 million from BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT) on Thursday. The capital flight represents the largest daily net outflow since the spot bitcoin ETF launched in January 2024.
why: BlackRock's IBIT is the largest spot Bitcoin exchange-traded fund globally, making its capital flows a key benchmark for institutional crypto demand.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Record redemptions in BlackRock's spot ETF reflect reduced institutional demand for bitcoin.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Record institutional capital withdrawals from spot bitcoin ETFs exerted severe downward liquidity pressure on digital assets.
